request.state:
L01: The allotment society met on the second Tuesday of the month.
L02: Eleven members attended and three sent apologies.
L03: The minutes of the last meeting were agreed without change.
L04: The water butt at the north gate is still leaking.
L05: A repair was promised for the spring.
L06: Two plots on the east row remain unlet.
L07: The waiting list holds nine names.
L08: A member asked about the cost of wood chip.
L09: The treasurer will bring prices to the next meeting.
L10: The autumn show will run on the last Saturday of September.
L11: Maureen Alder chairs the committee for a second year.
L12: The meeting closed at half past eight.

q1.instructions: Which line names the person who chairs the allotment committee?
